'''Laser trackers''' were [[Laser target designator|targeting devices]] used on [[Malaxan Firepower Incorporated/Legends|Malaxan Firepower Incorporated's]] [[FWG-5 Flechette Smart Pistol]]. It electronically painted a target, allowing the [[Flechette/Legends|flechettes]] to home in on their target<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> and even following the target's movements while in flight.<ref name="EGWT" />
